reader.requirement: At --std 85, the implementor may choose automatic alignment for internal (non-DISPLAY) formats, but must never auto-align a DISPLAY item within a record. The record itself may be synchronized. So a DISPLAY item in a record, whether in WORKING-STORAGE or a file record, sits at the next character position. WiseOwl takes no automatic alignment for any usage (DOC-A.1-195).

edition-consulted.switches: SYNCHRONIZED written on a group entry: refused COBOL0900 below 2023 (Constructs.SyncOnGroup2023), accepted at 2023

reader.edition-search: grep of every read of DataItem.Synchronized ('.Synchronized', 'Synchronized is', 'Synchronized ==') across src/: only binder screens, StrongTypeModel type-equivalence, RepositoryCodec/Reader and RepositoryAttributeRenderer read it; no layout, emitter or runtime member does. grep of DialectLevel|Edition.|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior in Model/PicInfo.cs and Model/DataItem.cs: none on SignKindFor, ByteForm, StorageWidth, Truncation, ElementaryByteWidth or ByteWidth. The record width computation has no alignment step at any edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: identical layout and file bytes at 85 and 2023 (gr9a stdout identical)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf04_02 covers WORKING-STORAGE DISPLAY and BINARY groups; it does not cover a file record (external media), packed-decimal neighbours, or an elementary 01 record with SYNC

probes.expected: DISPLAY items are not aligned within a record: the sequential file record is X(1)+COMP(2)+9(3)+PACKED S9(5)(3)+X(1) = 10 bytes with no padding, and the DISPLAY-only group is 7. An elementary 01 SYNC record is accepted (the record itself may be synchronized).

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: SYNCHRONIZED on a group item requires COBOL-2023
probes.expected: a group-level SYNC record is refused at 85 (§1985:VI.5.13.3 SR1); only an elementary record may carry SYNC

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.13.4 GR9  (5.13.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR9

reader.notes: GR9 forbids one thing, automatic alignment of DISPLAY items within a record, and the implementation aligns nothing at all. The written sequential record proves there is no padding on the external media. A failed OPEN or READ is not reachable by this rule, so class e was probed only through a successful WRITE and READ.

refuter.evidence: GR9 forbids only automatic alignment of DISPLAY items within a record; the width ladder (PicInfo.StorageWidth, DataItem.ByteWidth) has no alignment step at any edition. Probe r6.cob: the FD record (elementary 01 PIC S9(5) SYNC, 'the record itself may be synchronized') is accepted and written as 5 unpadded bytes; WORKING-STORAGE DISPLAY items after an X(1) sit at the next position (A1 image). cite.py: OK  §1985:VI.5.13.4 GR9  (5.13.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR9.
